title: JavaScript ORM query exception disclosed in a response
description: The response renders an error class from a JavaScript data mapper: Sequelize, Prisma, TypeORM or Knex. These classes are developer-visible by design and their messages carry the SQL text, the parameters and the model name, so a public response that includes them leaks both the schema and the data being queried.
remediation: Catch ORM errors in the request pipeline and return a generic error with a correlation id. Map known error codes to user-facing messages instead of rendering the exception.
limitation: One response body. The check recognises the class name; it does not prove the query succeeded or that the leaked parameters are still sensitive.
